Gamma matrices

Source: R/physics-hep-gamma.R
gamma-matrices.Rd

GammaMatrix is the tensor head of the Dirac gamma matrices, with one index of type LorentzIndex (dimension 4, dummy name L), as in sympy.physics.hep.gamma_matrices. kahane_simplify() removes the contracted gamma matrices of a product by Kahane's algorithm, gamma_trace() is the trace of a product of gamma matrices, simplify_gamma_expression() simplifies the gamma matrices of a tensor product, simplify_gpgp() contracts products of gamma matrices with momenta and extract_type_tens() splits a product into the tensors of one head and the rest.

Usage

LorentzIndex

GammaMatrix(...)

extract_type_tens(expression, component)

simplify_gamma_expression(expression)

simplify_gpgp(ex, sort = TRUE)

gamma_trace(t)

kahane_simplify(expression)

Arguments

...

Indices of the gamma matrix.

expression, t, ex

Tensor expressions.

component

A tensor head.

sort

Whether to sort the components first.

Value

A tensor expression, a matrix or, for extract_type_tens(), a list of two expressions.

Examples

i0 <- TensorIndex("i0", LorentzIndex); i1 <- TensorIndex("i1", LorentzIndex)
kahane_simplify(GammaMatrix(i0) * GammaMatrix(i1) * GammaMatrix(-i0))
#> -2*GammaMatrix(i1) 
gamma_trace(GammaMatrix(i0) * GammaMatrix(i1))
#> 4*metric(i0, i1)
